description: LowerNativeProgram fails with 'native callable materialization for FunctionId(N)/0 matched multiple native boundaries [2,4]/[8 boundaries]' on the reduce-bridge family (protocol-callback FunctionIds 160/189/192/193). This is the Fatal that makes 00420's RED gate non-Resolved (fz-f98.14), the transport shape-anchor disagreement (transport.rs:338) found in the f98 spikes, AND a NEW-red trigger when C2 (fz-f98.14.5) perturbs publication ordering. Distinct from the seal reseal (fz-f98.14.1): this is native-callable-boundary IDENTITY - one published BoundaryId resolving to multiple native boundaries when the reduce bridge's shape-polymorphic accumulator / capture identity fragments. Blocks 00420 Resolved and fz-f98.14.5. Investigate: how native lowering maps callable boundaries to BoundaryId and why the reduce-bridge family yields multiple for one id.
title: Native callable-boundary conflation: 'matched multiple native boundaries' for one BoundaryId (LowerNativeProgram Fatal)
